prompt:
Mobile app screen, portrait, shot straight on, filling the frame edge to edge — no phone mockup, no environment. This is the UI itself.

The interface is designed as an airport departures board paired with a segmented boarding pass. Near-black panel ground (#111418), warm off-white type (#E8E6E1), one alert orange (#FF7A00) reserved strictly for changed rows, grey (#8A8F98) for inactive.

Structure:
- Top: a departures-board header strip, "RITMO" at left and a monospaced clock-like "SEM 07/16" at right, with a hairline divider.
- The boarding pass: a wide panel divided by perforated dotted vertical lines into labeled segments, each segment a small uppercase label above a monospaced value — "DISTANCIA / 18 KM", "RITMO / 6:15–6:40", "ZONA / 2", "DURACIÓN / 1H55". At the far right of the pass, a tall vertical stub with a dense monospaced block code and a large sequence number "07".
- Below: the gate board — a fixed column grid of rows, one row per upcoming week, columns for week, date, session type, and kilometres, all in monospaced tabular figures, ranked by date. One single row is highlighted in alert orange and shows a small "AJUSTADO" tag, sitting slightly offset as if it just moved into place and stayed lit. All other rows are calm off-white on near-black.
- Bottom band: a disc indicator with concentric rings and "ESCUCHANDO…" in monospaced uppercase.

Typography: monospaced throughout for values and codes, condensed grotesque for labels. Rigid column grid, hairline rules, perforation dots. No rounded corners, no gradients, no glow. Spanish language UI. Efficient, mechanical, high contrast.
